Committee: Military and Veterans Affairs
Sponsor: Moore (P)
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/22/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 379 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama National Guard by an undetermined amount dependent upon Congress approving, on or before Fiscal Year 2025, the creation of a U.S. Space National Guard unit in the National Defense Authorization Act.
Dickie Drake, Chair
Military and Veterans Affairs
